DitherLogo.source: The logo, a PNG with a transparent background.
DitherLogo.ink: Colour of the ink when tone is mono.
DitherLogo.tone: mono is one ink, original keeps the file's own colours.
DitherLogo.logo-source: alpha reads the transparent background, dark reads a dark logo on a light, opaque background.
DitherLogo.outline: Keep a solid outline one cell wide, so the shapes stay exact however open the fill is.
DitherLogo.floor: Gradient fill: how much ink is left at the bottom, 0 to 1.
DitherLogo.matrix: Threshold pattern of the gradient fill.
DitherLogo.cell: Size of one cell. Larger cells give a chunkier mark.
DitherLogo.phase: Where in the sweep this logo starts, 0 to 1.
